title: Microsoft's sovereign pitch, Mistral's pending weights
summary: Microsoft widens its Sovereign Cloud with on-premises AI and EU oversight of engineer access. Mistral Large 4 is still a preview with weights promised, and Mistral's CPU forecasting models get a first retail test. The episode also covers the GDPR omnibus and Google's Universal Cart.
headlines: Microsoft widens its sovereign cloud with on-premises AI
Mistral Large 4 is live in preview, weights still pending
GDPR omnibus talks stall on AI training and legitimate interest
